versions.changelog:
Initial release of 飞书文件发送免费版 (v1.0.0).

- Provides tools to reliably send files and images via Feishu (Lark), supporting two-step upload and message sending.
- Fixes the issue where images sent as file paths appear as text instead of images.
- Supports HTML, ZIP, PDF, code files and other common file formats.
- Compatible with both domestic and international (Lark) versions.
- Offers CLI script, manual step, and AI助手 (exec) integration options.
- Supports sending to individual users (open_id) and groups (chat_id).
